reviews.x: I really had high hopes for this product. I used it diligently, 1-2x daily. I used this along with a natural blemish face wash to make sure my skin was clean before application. I also used foundation with sunscreen (SPF 15) to protect my skin during the day.  My outfit in the green is 1 month after daily use. Not only is there barely any difference, it also did not prevent my new scars from getting darker.  I would not recommend this for very dark acne scars.

reviews.t: Cystic acne and mild redness gone
reviews.x: I am 26 and have had acne since I was 16, that turned into cystic hormonal acne in my 20's. I had deep cystic acne around the jaw and ears, along with mild redness and textured on the cheeks and nose. My mother has rosacea, and I have been under the assumption that I am probably developing it as well, but have never been formally diagnosed.  After trying a free one month curology trial that cured my acne with a 8% azelaic acid prescription cream, I decided to try this before renewing for another
Been using for a year with my daughters acne.  Skin is clear and reduced number of outbreaks.  Everyone ask what she uses on her skin.

claims.text: Many reviewers report that it effectively reduces redness and helps with rosacea.
Several reviewers say it clears or improves acne and complexion.
Some reviewers report it reduces brown spots and hyperpigmentation, while a few say it was ineffective for hyperpigmentation.
Reviewers appreciate it as a cheaper alternative to prescription treatments like Finacea.
A few reviewers found it irritating or less effective than their prescription, causing redness and breakouts.
